evidence: Only module with a CONFIRMED cross-tenant mutation: flag_review loads a review by id with no ownership filter and sets status=flagged on ANY review in ANY tenant. Zero role check means a customer can also post the official provider reply (ACTOR_PROVIDER hardcoded). Public reputation content.
Zero authorization on a route that generates report runs and optional exports over tenant data; client-controlled filters dict. Single route, but data-aggregation and download-privacy surface.

A field technician can rewrite the tenant legal identity (business name, GST number, address, contact) and drive the verification workflow. Schema is a proper allow-list so no role/tenant escalation, which caps severity below customer_reviews.

Technician can replace or delete tenant brand assets (logo, shop photo). Object ownership IS enforced by the media access policy, and effects are reversible and audit-logged, so this is a persona-scope gap rather than an IDOR.

Zero authorization, but WS6 hypothesised risks do not materialise: no bulk targeting, no consent handling, no dispatch and no external delivery exist. All three routes are tenant-scoped raw SQL over draft content that an admin reviews before publication.
Parent service_id ownership unverified; catalog contribution affects customer-visible options but is admin-moderated.
Same parent-child ownership question as brand_provider_router on a single route.
Self-tenant scoped recommendation generation; lowest impact of the eight.
